title: GLRT Detector
text: 执行广义似然比检验检测，输入 4 路、输出 5 路；{Probability of false alarm} 指定虚警概率、{Output format} 输出数据的格式 Detection、{Output detection statistics and threshold} 输出检测统计量和阈值、{Enable known noise power input} 启用已知噪声功率输入、{Output MLEs of unknown signal parameters} 输出未知信号参数的最大似然估计、{Output estimated noise power} 输出估计噪声功率、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 输入数据 real-valued N -by- 1 vector | complex-valued N -by- 1 vector | real-valued N -by- M matrix | complex-valued N -by- M matrix

ports.name: Hyp
ports.summary: 增广线性等式约束矩阵 real-valued R -by-( P + 1) matrix | complex-valued R -by-( P + 1) matrix

ports.name: Obs
ports.summary: 观测矩阵 N -by- P -by- D array

ports.name: Ncov
ports.summary: 已知噪声功率 positive scalar

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: 检测结果 D -by- M logical-valued vector | 1-by- L integer-valued vector | 2-by- L integer-valued matrix

ports.name: Stat
ports.summary: 检测统计量 N -by- M (default) | 1-by- L

ports.name: Param
ports.summary: 信号参数的最大似然估计 P -by- M -by- D array

ports.name: N
ports.summary: 估计的噪声功率 positive scalar
